item.title: Texas Sound Meditation with Leala, Melissa, and James
item.description:
Tuesday, August 18, 2026 at 7 PM

Levy Park brings “Self Care” to a whole new level with Sound Healing led by Leala, Melissa, and James. A sound bath is a gentle, nurturing, and cathartic meditation experience for anyone looking to improve the quality of their life. This act of self-care is beneficial for anyone from beginners to advanced meditators who are ready to experience a greater sense of peace and well-being. The Levy Park Sound Baths will assist in clearing out that which is blocking the natural vitality while strengthening the connection and balance between mind, body, and soul. A collectively cultivated safe space offers participants an opportunity to deepen their own journey of self-love, healing or transformation. While relieving stress, tension and anxiety this sound immersion experience will have you feeling revitalized, relaxed and rejuvenate. Let the sounds wash away everything that no longer serves you as you set your intentions and manifest your desires!  

From Levy Park Houston

item.title: Houston Museum of Natural Science
item.description:
Sunday, August 30, 2026 at 2 PM

Location: Levy Park (Event Pavilion), TX

The Houston Museum of Natural Science comes to Levy Park to offer an opportunity to learn firsthand from Museum experts. Encounter real specimens and artifacts from the museum collection in an intimate, educational atmosphere. May 31: Rocks and Minerals Explore the fascinating characteristics of the most important building blocks of Earth’s crust. July 26: Energy Exciting demonstrations explore the remarkable forms of energy we encounter every day. August 30: Dinosaur Discovery Peek into the thrilling daily life of the dinosaur: investigate what dinosaurs ate, how they hunted, and the adaptations they developed to survive in a harsh prehistoric world. September 27: Birds Encounter an amazing variety of birds and discover their fascinating ancestral roots, while learning about their adaptations for success. October 25: Ancient Egypt From mummies to the pyramids, experience amazing architectural and cultural aspects of Ancient Egypt. November 29: Little Bodies, Big Jobs! Brings a selection of live arthropods from the Cockrell Butterfly Center to your classroom. Audiences of all ages will have a unique opportunity to meet some of the hardest workers in the invertebrate world up close and personal. December 13:  Astronomy  Investigate our place in space and ways we study this exciting place full of planets, moons, stars, and galaxies.

From Levy Park Houston
